mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 50 degrees with light drizzle by Fireman's Park under a waning crescent moon, and we are expecting an overnight low of 47 degrees with rain predicted.
The Public Works Department wants you to stay informed about street maintenance and utility projects by subscribing to the official city newsletter, which also highlights important city programs.

There is plenty to do, including Live Music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee all happening today, followed by Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory and ART House 360 events tomorrow.

In a report from October 25, Verona police officers arrested a 40-year-old local man for his first offence of O W I after discovering him unresponsive in his vehicle at the corner of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Stop by for today's delicious flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, as the store is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight.
